name: Bunny na Hip
source:
The porn bunny company group is going to expand its galaxy chain to the Earth. In order to investigate sexual orientation of the Earthlings, three girls are sent there. 
Main character is an ordinary unemployed man and he's chosen as a test object for a week. 
Every day main character needs to decide on the costume and the type of service to receive.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
